messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm onboarding model-x v1.2.0. I uploaded weights to HF earlier: https://huggingface.co/redwood/model-x/resolve/v1.2.0/pytorch_model.bin . HF shows all files, but our artifact-registry mirror hasn't finished. Also spotted a tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json missing explicit pad_token which breaks some legacy tokenizers. Anyone able to coordinate mirroring/checksum/access?
kevin: I can check the mirror job. We need the artifact manifest (sha256/md5) to validate. If you can paste the sha256 here I’ll re-run the verification.
registry-bot: Mirror job started for redwood/model-x:v1.2.0 -> s3://redwood-models/model-x/v1.2.0 (job_id=mir-20240311-9a7c). Will post status updates.
julia: Can you also confirm config.json + tokenizer.json were included? On a quick local load tokenizer.json is missing "pad_token": "<pad>" and "special_tokens_map" looks empty. That trips our tokenizer loader.
sam: For checksum generation locally:
```
sha256sum pytorch_model.bin > pytorch_model.bin.sha256
```
Or on mac: `shasum -a 256 pytorch_model.bin`
marta: Sha256 I generated on my laptop: 7f2c9a0b8d3e6f9b0a6c1e4a2d5f9b6c3e8a1b0c4d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6
HF path again: https://huggingface.co/redwood/model-x/resolve/v1.2.0/ (manifest is at https://huggingface.co/redwood/model-x/resolve/v1.2.0/manifest.json)
kevin: Mirror completed but initial size check failed: HF object 3221123456 bytes vs S3 object 3221123000 bytes. That usually means transfer chunking or gzipping difference. I'll run content-hash compare. Please avoid reuploading until we confirm.
julia: Tokenizer patch: set pad_token explicitly and include the small patch to special tokens. Example snippet to add to tokenizer.json:
```
"pad_token": "<pad>",
"special_tokens_map": {"pad_token": "<pad>", "unk_token": "<unk>"}
```
Also add "architectures": ["ModelXForCausalLM"] to config.json if missing.
natalie: On access: created IAM role `redwood-model-read` with s3:GetObject scoped to s3://redwood-models/model-x/* and attached to prod inference role. Ticket INF-1234 for audit/logs.
marta: Thanks — I'll patch tokenizer.json and config.json and reupload to HF with the same version tag (v1.2.0-rc1) to avoid breaking downstream. Will post new sha256 after upload. @kevin after I finish can you re-run the registry verify?
kevin: Yep — will re-run verify after you post the new checksum. ETA ~30m. :clock3:
registry-bot: Mirror verification failed (pre-patch): checksum mismatch for pytorch_model.bin (expected 7f2c9a0b..., saw c3b1f2e4...). Marked as UNVERIFIED.
sam: If you need a quick workaround for canary while we sort mirroring, we can create a presigned S3 URL and point canary to it. Not ideal long-term but unblocks testing.
marta: Uploaded patched tokenizer + config and reuploaded weights (v1.2.0-rc1). New sha256: 3b8a1c2d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1
kevin: Re-ran verification — checksums match now. Mirror tag created: model-x:v1.2.0:mirrored. S3 manifest: s3://redwood-models/model-x/v1.2.0/manifest.json . Registry-bot also updated indexes.
registry-bot: Verification success (job_id=mir-20240311-9a7c-run2). Tagging complete.
sam: :party_parrot: good to go for a canary run.
julia: I'll queue the canary with the new tokenizer fix and watch the evals for padding edge-cases.
marta: Thanks everyone — will follow up in the onboarding doc with final manifest + model card link.
